_comment: Contract: JSON structured birth data input for natal chart generation

field_types.name: string (1-80 chars, alphabetic + spaces/hyphens/apostrophes)
field_types.time_of_birth: string in HH:MM format (24-hour) or null
field_types.latitude: number (−90.0 to 90.0), optional — if omitted, resolved from location
field_types.longitude: number (−180.0 to 180.0), optional — if omitted, resolved from location
field_types.timezone: string IANA timezone identifier, optional — if omitted, inferred from city
